name: edit_file
description: Replace an exact string in a text file in the workspace, leaving the rest of it untouched. Use for a small change to a file already on disk, instead of writing the whole file back.

path.description: Path to edit, relative to the workspace root (e.g. "src/app.py"). Absolute paths are accepted but must still resolve inside the workspace root. The file has to exist already; use write_file to create one.

old_string.description: The exact text to replace, matched literally and never as a pattern. Copy it from the file, whitespace and indentation included. Unless replace_all is set it has to appear exactly once, so include the surrounding lines when a short string would match in several places.

new_string.description: The text to put in its place, inserted verbatim. An empty string deletes the matched text. It must differ from old_string.

replace_all.description: Replace every occurrence rather than a single one. Left false, a string appearing more than once is refused rather than one of them being picked.

output_schema.description: One line of the form "replaced N occurrence(s) in <path>", with no trailing newline.

exit_codes.2: invalid input (stdin was not a JSON object, or a parameter is missing, the wrong type, or an empty old_string, or old_string and new_string are identical)
exit_codes.3: no such file (nothing at the path; this tool edits a file that exists and does not create one)
exit_codes.4: not permitted (the path resolves outside the workspace root, is not a regular file, or is not readable and writable)
exit_codes.5: not a text file (the file could not be read as text, or its bytes do not survive being read back unchanged, so an edit would corrupt the rest of it)
exit_codes.6: no match (old_string does not appear in the file)
exit_codes.7: several matches (old_string appears more than once and replace_all was not set)
